01 / ROLE LOGIC

Field deployment is a production discipline.

The role asks for a senior creative who can work on live briefs, prototype AI-accelerated workflows, create high-craft examples, translate technical capability for leaders, and feed field learning back into Product, Partnerships and Sales.

01 · Diagnose
Map where the process breaks.

Start from the brief, approval path, aesthetic bar and practical constraints—not from a model demo.

02 · Prototype
Turn ambiguity into testable shots.

Define shot logic, reference states, transition behavior and failure conditions before scaling.

03 · Review
Keep humans at the taste gate.

Use diagnostics and explicit review checkpoints so generated output serves the creative intent.

04 · Handoff
Leave a reusable system behind.

Package the playbook, inputs, state logic and corrective actions so the team owns the workflow.

One Click Mute: versioned workflow, reviewed cut.

03 / FINISHED-CUT SUPPORT

DoomBrush: a finished-cut continuity study, not an isolated render.

A 95-second AI product short with a setup, threat, reveal and payoff structure. Its role here is narrow: support multi-shot character, world and product continuity across selected beats.

95s finished cutEric-approved exact link · private application use

What sampled frames support

  • The complete 95.018-second cut was decoded and reviewed end to end; sampled frames alone do not establish its motion, edit or audio quality.
  • Recurring character, creature, environment and product anchors across sampled beats.
  • A visual contrast between warm domestic baseline and cold supernatural intrusion.

What it does not yet prove

Full-cut motion/audio QA is complete. It found two P1 release defects: unstable fictional price text from 83.25–87.50s and a +0.6 dBFS true peak. Eric explicitly approves the current unlisted link for private application use despite those disclosed defects; no repair is implied.

Confirmed contribution · One Click Mute

End-to-end creator statement

Eric conceived and developed the spec film, created the applicable framework/storyboard materials, designed prompts, generated the AI imagery/video, directed and edited the cut, and completed sound/post with final responsibility. Canonical title: One Click Mute. VOLT ZERO is an earlier working title/material layer. The 46.846s reviewed cut contains five English VO lines. The 12.40–15.90 office section repeats wide setup beats and slightly slows the opening; the review track reaches 0.0 dBTP and should be limited below -1 dBTP for delivery.

Confirmed contribution · DoomBrush

End-to-end creator statement

Eric conceived and developed the fictional spec ad, completed Script_v2 and applicable storyboard work, designed prompts, generated the AI imagery/video, directed and edited the 95.018s cut, and completed sound/post with final responsibility. The 95.018-second cut expands beyond the documented 40-second Script_v2 plan through a 27.5-second exterior prologue, additional developed beats and a separate extended logo tail; the 68.50–74.50 brushing beat uses conspicuous comic face/foam deformation; the on-screen price is fictional in-world copy, not a real offer, but its 83.25–87.50s number drift remains a visual defect; the small-logo tail is long and sparse.
